```sql
WITH electricity_status AS (
    SELECT
        "Block",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "School Code") AS schools_without_electricity
    FROM
        "school_infrastructure"

        "Block"
),

    SELECT
        "Block",
        SUM("Girls 2024") + SUM("Boys 2024") AS total_2024_enrolment

        "school_enrolment_by_year"

        "Block"
)
SELECT
    e."Block",
    e.schools_without_electricment,
    COALESCE(en.total_2024_enrolment, 0) AS total_2024_enrolment
FROM
    electricity_status e
LEFT JOIN
    enrolment_by_block en ON e."Block" = en."Block"
```
